PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return to Movement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "safe postpartum return, rebuild base, gradual strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Restore & Walk (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Gentle Walk + Mobility A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          chest_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Gentle Walk + Mobility B":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_circles 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          leg_swings 3x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 2x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          quad_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Gentle Walk + Mobility C":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          marching 3x60 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          calf_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Walk + Activation A":

          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:

          walking 12m

          leg_swings 3x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 2x10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds

        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 25m "Walk + Mobility Flow":
        warmup:
          walking 12m
        main straight_sets:

          calf_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
